boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Colorado Boulder
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Boulder and CU destinations with currently published late operating hours.

cards.title: Fat Shack Boulder
cards.subtitle: 1110 13th St, Boulder
cards.notes: Use the published day-by-day schedule before heading to 13th Street; the Boulder location lists service as late as 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A 13th Street food stop with the latest listed hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Fat Shack lists its Boulder location at 1110 13th Street, open until 3 a.m. Tuesday through Saturday and 1 a.m. Sunday and Monday.
cards.access_notes: Published Boulder hours: Mon 4 p.m.–1 a.m.; Tue–Thu 4 p.m.–3 a.m.; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–3 a.m.; Sun 11 a.m.–1 a.m.

cards.title: IHOP Boulder
cards.subtitle: 1675 28th St, Boulder
cards.notes: For an all-hours option, confirm your order method and travel plan, then use the restaurant's published 28th Street location details.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's Boulder location page lists 1675 28th Street and says the restaurant is open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Hapa Sushi on Pearl Street
cards.subtitle: 1048 Pearl St, Boulder
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday dinner or takeout visit when the Pearl Street location publishes midnight closing for in-house dining.
cards.short_summary: Pearl Street sushi with midnight Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Hapa Sushi lists its Pearl Street Boulder location as open for in-house dining, delivery and takeout until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Hapa Sushi Pearl Street in Boulder
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Friday and Saturday, 11 a.m.–12 a.m.; Sunday through Thursday, 11 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Illegal Pete's Pearl
cards.subtitle: 1447 Pearl St, Boulder
cards.notes: Use the Pearl Street branch rather than the Hill branch for the later listed weekend closing time; check the day before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Pearl Street restaurant that publishes midnight Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Illegal Pete's lists its Pearl Street Boulder location at 1447 Pearl Street, open until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Published main hours: Friday 10:30 a.m.–12 a.m.; Saturday 9 a.m.–12 a.m.; other days close earlier.

cards.title: Pasta Jay's Boulder
cards.subtitle: 1001 Pearl St, Boulder
cards.notes: Schedule a Friday or Saturday Pearl Street meal when the restaurant lists its latest closing time, and call ahead for reservations if needed.
cards.short_summary: An Italian restaurant on Pearl Street open until 11 p.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Pasta Jay's Boulder lists its address as 1001 Pearl Street and publishes 11 p.m. closing on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Farrand Market
cards.subtitle: Farrand Hall, CU Boulder
cards.notes: When academic-year service resumes, use this Farrand Hall market for snacks and essentials; confirm the seasonal calendar before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A campus convenience market with published 11 p.m. academic-year hours.
cards.evidence_claim: CU Boulder describes Farrand Market as a convenience market and publishes academic-year hours until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: CU Boulder Dining Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published academic-year hours: Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–11 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday 11 a.m.–11 p.m. The page notes a summer renovation closure.

cards.title: Sewall Market
cards.subtitle: Sewall Hall, CU Boulder
cards.notes: Use this northeast-central-campus market for a late snack or basic supplies during its listed academic-year weekday service window.
cards.short_summary: A Sewall Hall market with 11 p.m. weekday academic-year hours.
cards.evidence_claim: CU Boulder describes Sewall Market as a convenience store and publishes academic-year weekday hours until 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: CU Boulder Dining Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published academic-year hours: Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–11 p.m.; closed Saturday and Sunday. The page notes a summer closure.

cards.title: Village Market
cards.subtitle: Village Center, CU Boulder
cards.notes: If you are at Williams Village or Bear Creek during the academic year, check this market's posted 11 p.m. schedule before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Village Center market with published 11 p.m. academic-year hours.
cards.evidence_claim: CU Boulder says Village Market serves students in Williams Village and Bear Creek and publishes academic-year hours until 11 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: CU Boulder Dining Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published academic-year hours: Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–11 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday 11 a.m.–11 p.m. The page notes a summer closure.

cards.title: The Connection
cards.subtitle: University Memorial Center, CU Boulder
cards.notes: Reserve a lane or check availability before visiting the UMC game space; its latest listed semester closing is 11 p.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A UMC bowling, billiards and games destination open until 11 p.m. on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: CU Boulder lists The Connection Bowling, Billiards & Games inside the UMC and publishes fall/spring Thursday–Saturday hours until 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published fall/spring hours: Sunday–Wednesday 1–10 p.m.; Thursday–Saturday 1–11 p.m. Summer hours differ.

cards.title: University Memorial Center
cards.subtitle: 1669 Euclid Ave, CU Boulder
cards.notes: Use the building as a late campus meeting point on Thursday through Saturday, and check the seasonal schedule for holiday or project changes.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub with midnight building hours on Thursday through Saturday during fall and spring.
cards.evidence_claim: CU Boulder lists fall and spring University Memorial Center building hours until midnight Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published fall/spring building hours: Thursday–Saturday 7 a.m.–12 a.m.; Monday–Wednesday close 11 p.m.; Sunday closes 10 p.m. Summer hours differ.
